label: Defined: P.Defined m: an ecumenical council of the practice defines m, condemning its denial by…
term: defined (by a council of the practice)
definition: `P.Defined m`: an ecumenical council of the practice defines m, condemning its denial by canon (anathema sit).
note: Stipulated as the form of Dei Filius's canons; whether such a definition belongs to the practice's grammar is the open bridge STMT-CONCILIAR-DEFINITION-IS-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD, not part of this sense.
